No masterclass

Your best thinking lives in 60-second reels

Someone who watched your 62.8k-view reel and wants more has two options: a newsletter or a call with you. There’s no moment where they see the whole Validate, Sell, Build method and decide to buy.

No ads

Every sale depends on today’s post

All of your demand comes from organic reach. A quiet posting week means a quiet pipeline, and there’s no way to turn ad spend into Founder Formula sales or coaching calls.

No qualifier

Your calendar does the filtering

Your coaching page goes straight to a 15-minute booking with no application and no price shown. Your time goes to anyone who books, whether or not they’re ready or able to invest.

No launch moment

Two $197 offers with no stage

The 37-Day Founder Formula and Becoming OS are ready to sell today, but nothing puts them in front of warm people at the moment they’re most motivated to act.

Your audience is there and your products are built. What’s missing is the event in the middle that sells them and shows you who’s ready for more.
